player_prompt.intro:
Yu Player {player_id} pilai {colour} ({piece}) long wanpela gem Othello.
Mipela i lakim yu i gat moa pisi bilong yu kala long boda sapos gem i pinis.
Long taim bilong yu, yu putim pisi olsem em i kisim wanpela o moa pisi bilong bikim i go pas long eni direkson (sideway, up-down, o kona-kona)-namel long yu new pisi na narapela pisi yu i gat. Ol pisi bilong bikim bai i tanim long yu kala.
Givim yu muv long forma '[row, col]'.

board.no_valid_moves_reset: {observation} Yu no inap mekim wanpela samting - ating yu mas abrusim.
board.no_valid_moves_step: {observation} I no gat wanpela samting i stret long mekim. Ating yu mas abrusim sampela hap bilong en.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Muv i mas i go long forma [row, col].
invalid_move.illegal: Ol i no orait long dispela pasin. {valid}

game_action.skipped: Man {pid} i no inap mekim wok bilong em yet.

game_message.must_skip: Player {pid} ({piece}) i nogat muv i orait na mas skelim.
